description.value: Bali Thai is a family-run Indonesian food court stall tucked into the commercial complex at 88 West Pender Street in downtown Vancouver, and one of the few spots in British Columbia specializing in authentic Indonesian cuisine. The menu spans Indonesian classics like Nasi Goreng, Sate Ayam, Laksa, Pempek, and Soto Betawi, alongside a build-your-own rice bowl featuring proteins like Beef Rendang and Lemongrass Curry Chicken. It's a quick-service stop with a distinctly different flavour profile from the typical downtown options, making it a memorable find for cyclists passing through the core.
